title: Smart RAG Chatbot
shortDescription: Document-grounded RAG chatbot — upload files, retrieve relevant chunks, and chat with answers grounded in your own knowledge base.
description: Smart RAG Chatbot is a retrieval-augmented chatbot built so users can upload documents and ask questions against their own files.
